---
title: "Cartograma comarcal de població estimada de Catalunya"
lang: ca
ref: population_cartogram_catalonia
format:
  gfm:
    output-file: population-cartogram-catalonia.generated.md
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
execute-dir: project
unaltraweb_compute:
  engine: r
  mode: figure
  inputs:
    - _practices/tigit-projecte-territorial/data/processed/catalonia-counties-icgc-20260120.gpkg
    - _practices/tigit-projecte-territorial/data/raw/mpiscatalunya.csv
    - _practices/tigit-projecte-territorial/data/raw/t396mun.csv
  outputs:
    - assets/img/thematic-cartography/population-proportional-symbols-catalonia-2025.svg
    - assets/img/thematic-cartography/population-cartogram-catalonia-2025.svg
---

```{r}
find_project_root <- function(start) {
  path <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(path, ".unaltraweb", "computations.yml"))) {
      return(path)
    }
    parent <- dirname(path)
    if (identical(parent, path)) {
      stop("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")
    }
    path <- parent
  }
}

root <- find_project_root(getwd())
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(sf))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggplot2))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(cartogramR))

counties <- sf::st_read(
  file.path(root, "_practices/tigit-projecte-territorial/data/processed/catalonia-counties-icgc-20260120.gpkg"),
  layer = "counties_250k",
  quiet = TRUE
)
municipality_index <- read.csv(
  file.path(root, "_practices/tigit-projecte-territorial/data/raw/mpiscatalunya.csv"),
  sep = ";", skip = 3, colClasses = "character", check.names = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)
geographic_indicators <- read.csv2(
  file.path(root, "_practices/tigit-projecte-territorial/data/raw/t396mun.csv"),
  skip = 4,
  colClasses = c("character", "character", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric"),
  check.names = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)

names(municipality_index)[1:4] <- c("mun_code", "mun_name", "county_code", "county_name")
names(geographic_indicators)[1:5] <- c("mun_code", "mun_name", "area_km2", "density", "entities")
municipal_data <- merge(
  municipality_index[, c("mun_code", "county_code", "county_name")],
  geographic_indicators[, c("mun_code", "area_km2", "density")],
  by = "mun_code"
)
municipal_data$population <- municipal_data$area_km2 * municipal_data$density
county_data <- aggregate(
  cbind(area_km2, population) ~ county_code + county_name,
  data = municipal_data,
  FUN = sum
)
county_data$population <- round(county_data$population)
counties <- merge(counties, county_data, by.x = "CODICOMAR", by.y = "county_code", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)

stopifnot(
  nrow(municipal_data) == 947,
  nrow(county_data) == 43,
  nrow(counties) == 43,
  !anyNA(counties$population),
  all(counties$NOMCOMAR[counties$CODICOMAR != "39"] == counties$county_name[counties$CODICOMAR != "39"]),
  counties$NOMCOMAR[counties$CODICOMAR == "39"] == "Val d'Aran",
  counties$county_name[counties$CODICOMAR == "39"] == "Aran"
)

# Tiny offshore components become distracting filaments under strong distortion.
primary_geometry <- lapply(sf::st_geometry(counties), function(geometry) {
  parts <- sf::st_cast(sf::st_sfc(geometry, crs = sf::st_crs(counties)), "POLYGON")
  parts[[which.max(as.numeric(sf::st_area(parts)))]]
})
sf::st_geometry(counties) <- sf::st_cast(
  sf::st_sfc(primary_geometry, crs = sf::st_crs(counties)),
  "MULTIPOLYGON"
)
counties <- sf::st_simplify(counties, dTolerance = 200, preserveTopology = TRUE)

counties$expansion_factor <-
  (counties$population / sum(counties$population)) /
  (counties$area_km2 / sum(counties$area_km2))
counties$expansion_class <- cut(
  counties$expansion_factor,
  breaks = c(-Inf, 0.5, 0.8, 1.25, 2, Inf),
  labels = c("< 0,5×", "0,5-0,8×", "0,8-1,25×", "1,25-2×", "> 2×"),
  right = FALSE
)

population_points <- sf::st_point_on_surface(counties)
population_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = counties, fill = "#e5ebef", color = "#7f929e", linewidth = 0.45) +
  geom_sf(
    data = population_points,
    aes(size = population),
    shape = 21, fill = "#4f8fae", color = "#315d70", stroke = 0.5, alpha = 0.78
  ) +
  scale_size_area(
    max_size = 27,
    breaks = c(100000, 500000, 1500000),
    labels = c("100.000", "500.000", "1.500.000"),
    name = "Població estimada (habitants)"
  ) +
  coord_sf(datum = NA, expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Població estimada de Catalunya, 2025",
    subtitle = "L'àrea de cada cercle és proporcional a la població estimada"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_family = "DejaVu Sans") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 22, color = "#17202a", hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 17, color = "#52616b", hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 8)),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#f8fafc", color = "#d8e0e6", linewidth = 0.55),
    plot.margin = margin(12, 12, 10, 12),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 17, color = "#315d70"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16, color = "#52616b"),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.margin = margin(t = 4),
    legend.box.spacing = grid::unit(2, "mm")
  ) +
  guides(size = guide_legend(title.position = "top", nrow = 1))

population_output <- file.path(
  root,
  "assets/img/thematic-cartography/population-proportional-symbols-catalonia-2025.svg"
)
dir.create(dirname(population_output), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
svglite::svglite(population_output, width = 7.2, height = 7.4, bg = "white")
print(population_map)
grDevices::dev.off()

cartogram_result <- cartogramR::cartogramR(
  counties,
  count = "population",
  method = "gsm",
  options = list(
    L = 512,
    relerror = 0.02,
    maxit = 50,
    center = "point_on_surface"
  )
)
cartogram_counties <- cartogram_result$cartogram
cartogram_counties <- sf::st_make_valid(cartogram_counties)

cartogram_share <- as.numeric(sf::st_area(cartogram_counties))
cartogram_share <- cartogram_share / sum(cartogram_share)
target_share <- cartogram_counties$population / sum(cartogram_counties$population)
mean_area_error <- mean(abs(cartogram_share - target_share) / target_share)
stopifnot(is.finite(mean_area_error), mean_area_error < 0.05)

focus_names <- c("Barcelonès", "Segrià")
cartogram_labels <- sf::st_point_on_surface(cartogram_counties[cartogram_counties$NOMCOMAR %in% focus_names, ])
cartogram_labels$label_color <- ifelse(cartogram_labels$NOMCOMAR == "Barcelonès", "white", "#17202a")

palette <- c(
  "< 0,5×" = "#4f8fae",
  "0,5-0,8×" = "#a9cbdc",
  "0,8-1,25×" = "#e8e5dc",
  "1,25-2×" = "#efb366",
  "> 2×" = "#c94f3d"
)
map_theme <- theme_void(base_family = "DejaVu Sans") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20, color = "#17202a", hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 19, color = "#52616b", hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 5)),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#f8fafc", color = "#d8e0e6", linewidth = 0.55),
    plot.margin = margin(9, 9, 9, 9),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

territorial_map <- ggplot(counties) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = expansion_class), color = "#ffffff", linewidth = 0.32) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = palette, drop = FALSE) +
  coord_sf(datum = NA) +
  labs(
    title = "Mapa territorial",
    subtitle = "Àrea = superfície real"
  ) +
  map_theme

cartogram_map <- ggplot(cartogram_counties) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = expansion_class), color = "#ffffff", linewidth = 0.32) +
  geom_sf_text(
    data = cartogram_labels,
    aes(label = NOMCOMAR, color = label_color),
    family = "DejaVu Sans", size = 6.7, fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = palette, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  coord_sf(datum = NA) +
  labs(
    title = "Cartograma contigu",
    subtitle = "Àrea ≈ població; veïnatges conservats"
  ) +
  map_theme

output <- file.path(root, "assets/img/thematic-cartography/population-cartogram-catalonia-2025.svg")
dir.create(dirname(output), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
svglite::svglite(output, width = 11.5, height = 7.8, bg = "white")
grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.rect(gp = grid::gpar(fill = "white", col = NA))
layout <- grid::grid.layout(
  nrow = 3,
  ncol = 2,
  heights = grid::unit(c(0.18, 0.65, 0.17), "npc"),
  widths = grid::unit(c(0.5, 0.5), "npc")
)
grid::pushViewport(grid::viewport(layout = layout))
grid::grid.text(
  "Població estimada de Catalunya per comarques, 2025",
  x = grid::unit(0.035, "npc"), y = grid::unit(0.68, "npc"), just = c("left", "center"),
  vp = grid::viewport(layout.pos.row = 1, layout.pos.col = 1:2),
  gp = grid::gpar(fontfamily = "DejaVu Sans", fontsize = 22, fontface = "bold", col = "#17202a")
)
grid::grid.text(
  "L'àrea representa població; el color indica la direcció de la deformació.",
  x = grid::unit(0.035, "npc"), y = grid::unit(0.27, "npc"), just = c("left", "center"),
  vp = grid::viewport(layout.pos.row = 1, layout.pos.col = 1:2),
  gp = grid::gpar(fontfamily = "DejaVu Sans", fontsize = 19, col = "#52616b")
)
print(territorial_map, vp = grid::viewport(layout.pos.row = 2, layout.pos.col = 1))
print(cartogram_map, vp = grid::viewport(layout.pos.row = 2, layout.pos.col = 2))

footer <- grid::viewport(layout.pos.row = 3, layout.pos.col = 1:2)
grid::grid.roundrect(
  x = 0.5, y = 0.52, width = 0.94, height = 0.72, r = grid::unit(2.5, "mm"),
  vp = footer,
  gp = grid::gpar(fill = "#eef5f8", col = "#c7dce5", lwd = 0.8)
)
legend_x <- c(0.07, 0.25, 0.43, 0.61, 0.79)
legend_labels <- c("< 0,5×", "0,5-0,8×", "0,8-1,25×", "1,25-2×", "> 2×")
for (i in seq_along(legend_x)) {
  grid::grid.rect(
    x = grid::unit(legend_x[i], "npc"), y = grid::unit(0.64, "npc"),
    width = grid::unit(0.025, "npc"), height = grid::unit(0.18, "npc"),
    vp = footer,
    gp = grid::gpar(fill = palette[[legend_labels[i]]], col = "white", lwd = 0.6)
  )
  grid::grid.text(
    legend_labels[i],
    x = grid::unit(legend_x[i] + 0.025, "npc"), y = grid::unit(0.64, "npc"), just = c("left", "center"),
    vp = footer,
    gp = grid::gpar(fontfamily = "DejaVu Sans", fontsize = 17, col = "#315d70")
  )
}
grid::grid.text(
  "Negativa < 0,8×  |  Gairebé neutra = 0,8-1,25×  |  Positiva > 1,25×",
  x = grid::unit(0.05, "npc"), y = grid::unit(0.27, "npc"), just = c("left", "center"),
  vp = footer,
  gp = grid::gpar(fontfamily = "DejaVu Sans", fontsize = 17, col = "#52616b")
)
grDevices::dev.off()
```

El cartograma contigu conserva els veïnatges i aproxima l'àrea de cada comarca al seu pes demogràfic; el Barcelonès s'expandeix i el Segrià es contrau.")
